junction.name: 4th Street Southwest & E Street Southwest, Washington DC

claims.text: 4th Street Southwest & E Street Southwest had 66 injury crashes in police records since 2021-10-31: 1 pedestrian injured, 1 cyclist injured and 0 people killed.
At the U.S. DOT's values that harm costs about $4.5 million a year.
No crash pattern here stands out against the city's worst crash locations.
The city's Leading Pedestrian Interval signals: not shown (at 267 sites the change in pedestrian injury crashes (-19%, 95% interval -35% to +1%) could be zero).
Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons would avoid about 0.1 crashes a year (CMF 9024, the record FHWA's fact sheet cites; evidence: the record FHWA cites), worth $32,000 a year.
The District Department of Transportation (DDOT) is responsible for 4th Street Southwest (no route reference, so presumed a city street).
A request letter to the District Department of Transportation (DDOT) is ready to draft from these facts.
